python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,"/usr/lib/mios"); import mios_toml; json.dump({"keybindings":mios_toml.load_merged()["keybindings"]},open("/tmp/mios-keybindings-build.json","w"))'
/usr/libexec/mios/mios-unit-gen keybindings --from-json /tmp/mios-keybindings-build.json --emit-json | \
    python3 -c 'import json,sys,pathlib; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [(pathlib.Path("/")/p).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) or (pathlib.Path("/")/p).write_text(v) for p,v in d.items()]'
rm -f /tmp/mios-keybindings-build.json
command -v dconf >/dev/null && dconf update
mios_ok "Rendered Hyprland, Sway, Alacritty, WSL terminal profile and tmux theme from mios.toml"

# After the RPM, which ships its own copy at this path; the tracked overlay file is the one source.
_session="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../usr/share/wayland-sessions/hyprland.desktop"
[ -f "$_session" ] || _session="${CTX:-/ctx}/usr/share/wayland-sessions/hyprland.desktop"
install -D -m 0644 "$_session" /usr/share/wayland-sessions/hyprland.desktop
mios_ok "Registered /usr/share/wayland-sessions/hyprland.desktop"

mkdir -p /etc/hypr
if [[ ! -e /etc/hypr/hyprland.conf ]]; then
    ln -sf /usr/share/mios/hyprland/hyprland.conf /etc/hypr/hyprland.conf
fi

# Seed the native Lua entry used by current Hyprland.
install -D -m 0644 /etc/skel/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua /etc/hypr/hyprland.lua

entries.title: 66-bake-quickshell.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/bin/bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Installs Qt6 build-time tools, clones the quickshell repository, gates it on closed Qt property update groups
# (src/quickshell/check-update-groups.py; carries the HyprlandToplevel fix for older refs), compiles it, and deploys the default declarative QML pa...
# AI-doc: usr/share/doc/mios/manual/automation.md
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/packages.sh"

DESTDIR="${MIOS_QUICKSHELL_DESTDIR:-${DESTDIR:-}}"

if [[ "${MIOS_QUICKSHELL_SKIP_DEPS:-0}" != 1 ]] && command -v install_packages >/dev/null; then
    mios_log "Installing Qt6 build dependencies"
    install_packages "quickshell-build" || mios_log "quickshell-build packages not installable here; using what is present"
fi

mios_log "Compiling quickshell from upstream"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/common.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

PIN_REF="${MIOS_BUILD_BAKE_REFS_QUICKSHELL:-latest}"
[ "$PIN_REF" != latest ] || PIN_REF="$(/usr/libexec/mios/mios-bake-plan latest-git "${MIOS_URL_QUICKSHELL:-https://github.com/quickshell-mirror/quickshell.git}")" || { echo "quickshell: newest release could not be resolved" >&2; exit 1; }
mios_log "Quickshell pin ref: ${PIN_REF}"

BUILD_DIR="/tmp/quickshell-build"
QUICKSHELL_OK=""

for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    mios_log "Compilation attempt $attempt/3"
    cd /tmp
    rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"

    if ! git clone "${MIOS_URL_QUICKSHELL:-https://github.com/quickshell-mirror/quickshell.git}" "$BUILD_DIR"; then
        mios_warn "Git clone failed on attempt $attempt"
        sleep $((attempt * 8))
        continue
    fi

    cd "$BUILD_DIR"
    if ! git checkout "$PIN_REF"; then
        mios_warn "Git checkout to $PIN_REF failed on attempt $attempt"
        sleep $((attempt * 8))
        continue
    fi

    git submodule sync --recursive || true
    if ! git submodule update --init --recursive --force; then
        mios_warn "Git submodule update failed on attempt $attempt"
        sleep $((attempt * 8))
        continue
    fi

    # Every Qt property update group must close on all paths (src/quickshell/check-update-groups.py). Quickshell refs
    # before upstream 1bd5b083 return inside one in HyprlandToplevel::updateFromObject(); the shell's computed
    # bindings then freeze and the status island / dock stop reserving their rows (tiled windows run under them).
    # Carry the fix for such refs; refuse a ref that leaks anywhere else.
    check_tool="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../src/quickshell/check-update-groups.py"
    [[ -f "$check_tool" ]] || check_tool="/src/quickshell/check-update-groups.py"
    patch_file="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../src/quickshell/patches/hyprland-toplevel-update-group.patch"
    [[ -f "$patch_file" ]] || patch_file="/src/quickshell/patches/hyprland-toplevel-update-group.patch"

    if ! python3 -I "$check_tool" "$BUILD_DIR/src"; then
        git -C "$BUILD_DIR" apply --verbose "$patch_file" \
            || { mios_err "Quickshell ${PIN_REF} leaks a Qt property update group and the carried fix no longer applies"; exit 1; }
        python3 -I "$check_tool" "$BUILD_DIR/src" \
            || { mios_err "Quickshell ${PIN_REF} still leaks a Qt property update group"; exit 1; }
        mios_log "Quickshell ${PIN_REF}: carried the HyprlandToplevel update-group fix"
    fi

    # Hermetic pkgconfig for GBM if gbm.pc is absent from host
    if ! pkg-config --exists gbm 2>/dev/null && [[ -e /usr/lib64/libgbm.so.1 ]]; then
        mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/pkgconfig"
        cat << 'EOF' > "$BUILD_DIR/pkgconfig/gbm.pc"
prefix=/usr
libdir=/usr/lib64
includedir=/usr/include

Name: gbm
Description: Generic Buffer Management
Version: 26.2.4
Libs: -L${libdir} -lgbm
Cflags: -I${includedir}
EOF
        export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="${BUILD_DIR}/pkgconfig:${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:-}"
    fi

    rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && cd build
    if (cmake -GNinja -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCRASH_REPORTER=OFF .. 2>/dev/null || \
        cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCRASH_REPORTER=OFF .. 2>/dev/null || \
        cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..) && \
       (ninja 2>/dev/null || cmake --build . --parallel "$(nproc)" 2>/dev/null || make -j1) && \
       (DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" cmake --install . 2>/dev/null || make install DESTDIR="$DESTDIR"); then
        if [[ -x "${DESTDIR}/usr/bin/quickshell" || -x /usr/bin/quickshell ]]; then
            QUICKSHELL_OK=1
            break
        fi
    fi

    mios_warn "Build failed on attempt $attempt"
    sleep $((attempt * 8))
done

if [[ -z "$QUICKSHELL_OK" ]]; then
    mios_warn "Quickshell build failed after 3 attempts"
    exit 1
fi

record_version quickshell "$PIN_REF" "https://github.com/quickshell-mirror/quickshell/tree/${PIN_REF}"

if [[ ! -s "${DESTDIR}/usr/share/mios/quickshell/Config.qml" && ! -s /usr/share/mios/quickshell/Config.qml ]]; then
    mios_log "Writing canonical ${DESTDIR}/usr/share/mios/quickshell/Config.qml"
    mkdir -p "${DESTDIR}/usr/share/mios/quickshell"
    cat << 'EOF' > "${DESTDIR}/usr/share/mios/quickshell/Config.qml"
import QtQuick
import Quickshell

ShellRoot {
    PanelWindow {}
    Sidebar {}
    Notifications { id: notifs }
}
EOF
    chmod 0644 "${DESTDIR}/usr/share/mios/quickshell/Config.qml"
fi
mios_ok "Installed ${DESTDIR}/usr/bin/quickshell and verified ${DESTDIR}/usr/share/mios/quickshell/Config.qml"

entries.title: 67-bake-portal.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/bin/bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=universal
# AI-hint: Installs MiOS-Portal, the Firefox+Surfer build of mios.toml [desktop.portal.gecko], from the off-image builder's artifact into [desktop.portal.gecko].install_dir: provenance from metrics.json, the artifact's stage proven equal to the CURRENT src/mios-portal by mios-portal-tree verify-stage (one implementation with the builder's stage, fail-closed), tarball + the artifact's install-overlay laid in root-owned and world-readable, then proven equal to the artifact by verify-install; strictly zero network and zero compilation (Law 12).
# AI-doc: usr/share/doc/mios/manual/automation.md
# AI-related: usr/share/mios/mios.toml, src/mios-portal/install/, usr/libexec/mios/mios-portal-tree, usr/libexec/mios/mios-portal-build, tests/test-bake-portal.py
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done

# Capture and validate incoming DEST parameters BEFORE common.sh/globals.sh sources
# to ensure explicit empty strings fail closed and are not coerced by globals defaults.
if [ "${DEST+x}" = "x" ] && [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    mios_err "DEST is empty"; exit 1
fi
if [ "${MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR+x}" = "x" ] && [ -z "$MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR" ]; then
    mios_err "DEST is empty"; exit 1
fi
_INCOMING_DEST="${DEST:-}"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/common.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

# Identity and paths come only from the SSOT projection (automation/lib/globals.sh); an unset one
# stops the phase instead of falling back to a literal.
for _v in MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_NAME MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_BINARY \
          MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_BUILDER_ARTIFACT_ROOT; do
    [ -n "${!_v:-}" ] || { mios_err "${_v} unresolved -- render automation/lib/globals.sh from mios.toml"; exit 1; }
done
NAME="$MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_NAME"
BIN="$MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_BINARY"
DEST="${_INCOMING_DEST:-$MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR}"
# One implementation of the stage (sentinel fill, lane mozconfig, branding icons) for the builder
# and this phase; it needs the product tree, the SSOT and python3-pillow, and fails without them.
TREE_TOOL="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../usr/libexec/mios/mios-portal-tree"
[ -f "$TREE_TOOL" ] || TREE_TOOL=/usr/libexec/mios/mios-portal-tree
[ -f "$TREE_TOOL" ] || { mios_err "mios-portal-tree is missing; the artifact cannot be verified"; exit 1; }

# DEST guard: never allow unconstrained or root deletions
[ -n "${DEST:-}" ] || { mios_err "DEST is empty"; exit 1; }
if [ "$DEST" = "/" ] || [ "$DEST" = "/usr" ] || [ "$DEST" = "/usr/lib" ] || [ "$DEST" = "/usr/lib/mios" ]; then
    mios_err "DEST '$DEST' is a protected system directory; refusing rm -rf"; exit 1
fi
case "$DEST" in
    "$MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR"|*/"${MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR#/}") ;;
    *) mios_err "DEST '$DEST' is not [desktop.portal.gecko].install_dir ($MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR)"; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR" in
    /|/usr|/usr/lib|/usr/lib/mios|*/..|*/../*|"") mios_err "install_dir '$MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_GECKO_INSTALL_DIR' is not a dedicated directory"; exit 1 ;;
esac

# Locate artifact: explicit run (MIOS_PORTAL_ARTIFACT_DIR), build context, or the newest run under
# the host artifact root. Whichever is chosen must still pass every check below.
CANDIDATES=()
[ -z "${MIOS_PORTAL_ARTIFACT_DIR:-}" ] || CANDIDATES+=("${MIOS_PORTAL_ARTIFACT_DIR}")
[ -z "${CTX:-}" ] || CANDIDATES+=("${CTX}/artifacts/portal" "${CTX}/artifacts/mios-portal")
CANDIDATES+=("${MIOS_DESKTOP_PORTAL_BUILDER_ARTIFACT_ROOT}")

RUN=""
for cand in "${CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
    if [ -d "$cand" ]; then
        if [ -f "$cand/manifest.json" ]; then
            RUN="$cand"
            break
        fi
        found="$(find "$cand" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -name manifest.json -printf '%h\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n1 || true)"
        if [ -n "$found" ]; then
            RUN="$found"
            break
        fi
    fi
done

[ -n "$RUN" ] || { mios_err "no ${NAME} artifact found under candidates (${CANDIDATES[*]}) -- run off-image builder first (fatal=true)"; exit 1; }
RUN="$(cd "$RUN" && pwd)"
mios_log "${NAME} artifact: ${RUN}"

# Provenance: the run built the committed tree (staged:), exited 0 and passed its smoke test; the
# manifest names a package and executable. Missing metrics, stage or overlay fail closed.
read -r PKG PKG_SHA EXE VERSION < <(python3 -I - "${RUN}" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
run = sys.argv[1]
def load(name):
    p = os.path.join(run, name)
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        sys.exit(f"{name} is missing from the artifact")
    with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        return json.load(fh)
m, met = load("manifest.json"), load("metrics.json")
if met.get("exit") != 0:
    sys.exit(f"builder metrics record exit {met.get('exit')!r}, not 0")
prod = str(met.get("product", ""))
if not prod.startswith("staged:"):
    sys.exit(f"builder metrics record product {prod!r}; only a staged src/mios-portal build is installable")
if str(met.get("smoke")) != "0":
    sys.exit(f"builder metrics record smoke {met.get('smoke')!r}; the artifact never passed its smoke test")
for name in ("stage.json",):
    if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(run, name)):
        sys.exit(f"{name} is missing from the artifact; it cannot be tied to the current tree")
if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(run, "install-overlay")):
    sys.exit("install-overlay/ is missing from the artifact")
pkg = m["package"]
fields = (os.path.basename(pkg["file"]), pkg["sha256"], os.path.basename(pkg["executable"]), m["resolved"]["firefox"])
if not all(isinstance(f, str) and f and " " not in f for f in fields):
    sys.exit(f"manifest.json fields are incomplete: {fields!r}")
print(*fields)
PY
) || { mios_err "${RUN} provenance check failed"; exit 1; }
[ -n "${VERSION:-}" ] || { mios_err "${RUN} provenance check failed"; exit 1; }

TARBALL="${RUN}/${PKG}"
[ -f "$TARBALL" ] || { mios_err "${TARBALL} named by manifest is missing"; exit 1; }
[ "$(sha256sum "$TARBALL" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$PKG_SHA" ] || { mios_err "${TARBALL} sha256 mismatch"; exit 1; }

# The artifact's stage must equal the stage of the CURRENT product tree, and its install overlay
# the staged install/ (bidirectional; no Pillow, no tree or no stage.json -> fail).
python3 -I "$TREE_TOOL" verify-stage --stage "${RUN}/stage.json" --overlay "${RUN}/install-overlay" \
    || { mios_err "Stage hash check failed: ${RUN} was not built from the current src/mios-portal"; exit 1; }

mios_log "Installing ${NAME} ${VERSION} from ${TARBALL} into ${DEST}"
PARENT="$(dirname "$DEST")"
mkdir -p "$PARENT"
NEW="$(mktemp -d "${PARENT}/.$(basename "$DEST").new.XXXXXX")"
OLD=""
cleanup() { [ -z "${NEW:-}" ] || rm -rf "$NEW"; [ -z "${OLD:-}" ] || rm -rf "$OLD"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
tar -xJf "$TARBALL" -C "$NEW" --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner
# The overlay is the artifact's own copy of the staged install/ (verified above), never src/.
tar -C "${RUN}/install-overlay" -cf - . | tar -xf - -C "$NEW" --no-same-owner
# Root-owned (when root), world-readable, nothing group/other-writable: the user who runs the
# browser must read every file, and must not be able to edit what fapolicyd lets execute.
[ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] || chown -R 0:0 "$NEW"
chmod -R u+rwX,go+rX,go-w "$NEW"
chmod 0755 "$NEW"
[ -x "${NEW}/${EXE}" ] || { mios_err "${EXE} is not executable after unpack"; exit 1; }
[ "$EXE" = "$BIN" ] || ln -sfn "$EXE" "${NEW}/${BIN}"

if [ -e "$DEST" ] || [ -L "$DEST" ]; then
    OLD="$(mktemp -u "${PARENT}/.$(basename "$DEST").old.XXXXXX")"
    mv "$DEST" "$OLD"
fi
mv "$NEW" "$DEST"
NEW=""
# On a live SELinux host the staged tree carries its temp dir's labels; give it the policy's.
# (An image build has no SELinux loaded, so selinuxenabled is false there and this is skipped.)
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] && command -v selinuxenabled >/dev/null 2>&1 && selinuxenabled; then
    restorecon -R "$DEST" || { mios_err "restorecon -R ${DEST} failed"; exit 1; }
fi

ROOT_OWNED=()
[ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] || ROOT_OWNED=(--root-owned)
if ! python3 -I "$TREE_TOOL" verify-install --run "$RUN" --dest "$DEST" --binary "$BIN" "${ROOT_OWNED[@]}"; then
    mios_err "${DEST} is not the artifact ${RUN} after install"
    if [ -n "$OLD" ]; then
        rm -rf "$DEST" && mv "$OLD" "$DEST" && OLD="" && mios_err "rolled back to the previous ${DEST}"
    fi
    exit 1
fi

record_version mios-portal "$VERSION" "${RUN}/manifest.json" 2>/dev/null || true
mios_ok "Installed ${NAME} ${VERSION} into ${DEST}"

entries.title: 68-bake-kvmfr.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Builds, signs, and embeds the Looking Glass kvmfr kernel module into the image during the container build process to enable high-performance KVMFR support for the guest.
set -euo pipefail

for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done

source "$(dirname "$0")/lib/common.sh"

KVER="$(find /usr/lib/modules/ -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf "%f\n" 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)"
if [[ -z "$KVER" ]]; then
    mios_warn "No kernel modules directory; cannot determine kernel version"
    mios_skip "kvmfr bake - Looking Glass runs IVSHMEM-only mode"
    exit 0
fi
mios_log "Building against kernel: $KVER"

if [[ ! -d "/usr/src/kernels/$KVER" ]]; then
    mios_log "Installing kernel-devel-$KVER"
    set +e
    $DNF_BIN "${DNF_SETOPT[@]}" install -y "${DNF_OPTS[@]}" "kernel-devel-$KVER" >/dev/null 2>&1
    RC=$?
    set -e
    if [[ $RC -ne 0 ]]; then
        set +e
        AVAIL="$(rpm -qa 'kernel-devel*' 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')"
        set -e
        mios_skip "no exact kernel-devel for $KVER (dnf rc=$RC; installed: ${AVAIL:-none})"
        mios_warn "The ucore-hci base kernel $KVER is typically newer/older than"
        mios_warn "F44's repo-published kernel-devel. Project principle is 'never"
        mios_warn "Upgrade base kernel in-container', so kvmfr is skipped here"
        mios_warn "Looking Glass still works in IVSHMEM-only mode. To enable kvmfr"
        mios_warn "On the booted image once the kernel matches, run:"
        mios_warn "  sudo dnf install kernel-devel-\$ akmod-kvmfr"
        mios_warn "  sudo akmods"
        exit 0
    fi
fi

mios_log "Enabling hikariknight/looking-glass-kvmfr COPR"
set +e
$DNF_BIN "${DNF_SETOPT[@]}" copr enable -y hikariknight/looking-glass-kvmfr 2>/dev/null
set -e

mios_log "Installing akmod-kvmfr"
set +e
$DNF_BIN "${DNF_SETOPT[@]}" install -y "${DNF_OPTS[@]}" akmod-kvmfr >/dev/null 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
if [[ $RC -ne 0 ]]; then
    mios_skip "akmod-kvmfr install failed (rc=$RC; COPR unreachable or package missing)"
    mios_warn "Verify COPR enabled: dnf5 copr list | grep looking-glass-kvmfr"
    exit 0
fi

mios_log "Akmods"
set +e
akmods --force --kernels "$KVER" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/[akmods] /'
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
if [[ $RC -ne 0 ]]; then
    mios_skip "akmods build failed (rc=$RC)"
    mios_warn "Checking /var/cache/akmods/kvmfr/ for build log"
    find /var/cache/akmods/ -name '*.log' -exec tail -50 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 0
fi

KMOD_PATH="/usr/lib/modules/$KVER/extra/kvmfr/kvmfr.ko"
if [[ -f "$KMOD_PATH" ]] || [[ -f "${KMOD_PATH}.xz" ]] || [[ -f "${KMOD_PATH}.zst" ]]; then
    mios_ok "Kvmfr.ko baked at /usr/lib/modules/$KVER/extra/kvmfr/"
    ls -la "/usr/lib/modules/$KVER/extra/kvmfr/"
else
    mios_skip "kvmfr.ko not found after akmods build"
    mios_warn "Listing /usr/lib/modules/$KVER/extra/:"
    ls -la "/usr/lib/modules/$KVER/extra/" 2>/dev/null || mios_warn "No extra/ dir"
    exit 0
fi

mios_log "Depmod -a -b /usr $KVER"
depmod -a -b /usr "$KVER" || mios_warn "Depmod failed"

PRIV_KEY="/etc/pki/akmods/private/private_key.priv"
PUB_KEY="/etc/pki/akmods/certs/public_key.der"
if [[ -f "$PRIV_KEY" && -f "$PUB_KEY" ]]; then
    mios_log "Signing kvmfr.ko with akmods private key"
    SIGN_FILE="/usr/src/kernels/$KVER/automation/sign-file"
    if [[ -x "$SIGN_FILE" ]]; then
        for ko in /usr/lib/modules/$KVER/extra/kvmfr/*.ko; do
            [[ -f "$ko" ]] && "$SIGN_FILE" sha256 "$PRIV_KEY" "$PUB_KEY" "$ko" && \
                mios_ok "Signed: $ko"
        done
    else
        mios_warn "Sign-file not found at $SIGN_FILE; kvmfr unsigned"
    fi
else
    mios_log "Ublue MOK private key not in image; users enroll MOK"
    mios_log "Kvmfr will use the public cert shipped by ublue-os-akmods-addons"
fi

mios_ok "Kvmfr.ko installed under /usr/lib/modules/$KVER/extra/kvmfr/"

entries.title: 69-bake-lookingglass-client.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Builds the Looking Glass client from upstream gnif/LookingGlass and installs it to /usr/bin/looking-glass-client. mios.toml [build.bake_refs].lookingglass = "latest" means the tip of the upstream default branch (the IDD era: the Windows guest runs the Looking Glass IDD of the same commit); the resolved commit is only logged and recorded as build output in /usr/share/mios/looking-glass/build.json, never written back to the SSOT.
# AI-related: usr/libexec/mios/vfio/setup-looking-glass.py (--write-client-ini; --provision-guest installs the IDD of the recorded commit in the MiOS-Xbox guest), usr/share/mios/windows/mios-looking-glass-idd.ps1, usr/share/mios/mios.toml [build.bake_refs] [vm.looking_glass] [packages.looking-glass-build]
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/lib/common.sh"
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/lib/packages.sh"

# MIOS_LG_DESTDIR stages the install under another root (a dev-container build copied onto a running
# host); empty for the image build. MIOS_LG_JOBS caps make's parallelism (default: all CPUs).
DESTDIR="${MIOS_LG_DESTDIR:-}"
LG_REPO="https://github.com/gnif/LookingGlass.git"
LG_BIN="$DESTDIR/usr/bin/looking-glass-client"
LG_RECORD="$DESTDIR/usr/share/mios/looking-glass/build.json"

# Client config from mios.toml [vm.looking_glass] (SPICE host/port/audio, shmFile, win:/egl: options) ->
# /etc/looking-glass-client.ini, the same values the VM domain profile carries; mios-vfio-setup.service
# re-projects it on every boot.
_LG_SETUP=/usr/libexec/mios/vfio/setup-looking-glass.py
[[ -x "$_LG_SETUP" ]] || _LG_SETUP="$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/libexec/mios/vfio/setup-looking-glass.py"
python3 "$_LG_SETUP" --write-client-ini "$DESTDIR/etc/looking-glass-client.ini" || mios_warn "Looking Glass client config not written"

# "latest" floats with upstream: the default-branch HEAD (never a pinned commit). Any other value is a
# branch or tag name.
LG_REF="${MIOS_BUILD_BAKE_REFS_LOOKINGGLASS:-latest}"
if [[ "$LG_REF" == latest ]]; then
    LG_SHA="$(git ls-remote "$LG_REPO" HEAD | awk '{print $1; exit}')" || true
else
    LG_SHA="$(git ls-remote "$LG_REPO" "refs/tags/$LG_REF^{}" "refs/heads/$LG_REF" "refs/tags/$LG_REF" | awk '{print $1; exit}')" || true
fi
[[ "$LG_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || die "Looking Glass: ref '$LG_REF' could not be resolved on $LG_REPO"
mios_log "Looking Glass: ref '$LG_REF' resolves to $LG_SHA"

if [[ -x "$LG_BIN" && -r "$LG_RECORD" ]] && grep -q "\"commit\": \"$LG_SHA\"" "$LG_RECORD"; then
    mios_ok "Looking-glass-client already built from $LG_SHA"
    exit 0
fi

MISSING=""
for tool in cmake make gcc git; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING="${MISSING}${tool} "
done
if [[ -n "$MISSING" ]]; then
    mios_skip "missing toolchain: $MISSING"
    exit 0
fi

mios_log "Ensure Looking Glass client build deps from SSOT"
install_packages "looking-glass-build"

BUILD_DIR="/tmp/LookingGlass-build"
LG_OK=""
LG_VERSION=""
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    mios_log "Compile attempt $attempt/3"
    cd /                 # leave any prior attempt's build dir BEFORE removing it -- otherwise the
    rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"  # next git clone runs from a deleted CWD ("Unable to read current working directory").

    _branch=() _fref=HEAD
    [[ "$LG_REF" == latest ]] || { _branch=(--branch "$LG_REF"); _fref="$LG_REF"; }
    if ! git clone --depth 1 "${_branch[@]}" "$LG_REPO" "$BUILD_DIR"; then
        mios_warn "Git clone failed on attempt $attempt"
        sleep $((attempt * 8))
        continue
    fi
    cd "$BUILD_DIR"
    LG_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
    # The version upstream builds report (git describe --tags --abbrev=10). A shallow clone has no tags:
    # deepen only back to the newest release tag and count the commits since it.
    LG_TAG="$(git ls-remote --tags --refs "$LG_REPO" | awk -F/ '{print $3}' | grep -E '^B[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*$' | sort -V | tail -1 || true)"
    LG_VERSION="$(git rev-parse --short=10 HEAD)"
    if [[ -n "$LG_TAG" ]] && git fetch -q --shallow-exclude="$LG_TAG" origin "$_fref" 2>/dev/null; then
        _n="$(git rev-list --count HEAD)"
        LG_VERSION="${LG_TAG}-${_n}-g$(git rev-parse --short=10 HEAD)"
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$LG_VERSION" > VERSION
    if ! git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1; then
        mios_warn "Submodule fetch failed on attempt $attempt"
        sleep $((attempt * 8))
        continue
    fi

    mios_log "Configure client build ($LG_VERSION, $LG_SHA)"
    mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/client/build"
    cd "$BUILD_DIR/client/build"
    if ! cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
               -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=/usr/lib \
               -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
               -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='-Wno-error -Wno-error=maybe-uninitialized -Wno-maybe-uninitialized' \
               -DENABLE_LIBDECOR=ON \
               -DENABLE_PIPEWIRE=ON \
               -DENABLE_PULSEAUDIO=OFF \
               -DENABLE_BACKTRACE=OFF \
               ..; then
        mios_warn "Cmake configure failed on attempt $attempt"
        sleep $((attempt * 8))
        continue
    fi

    mios_log "Build looking-glass-client"
    if ! make -j"${MIOS_LG_JOBS:-$(nproc)}"; then
        mios_warn "Make failed on attempt $attempt"
        sleep $((attempt * 8))
        continue
    fi

    mios_log "Install binary to $LG_BIN"
    install -Dm0755 looking-glass-client "$LG_BIN"
    if [[ -x "$LG_BIN" ]]; then
        LG_OK=1
        break
    fi
done

if [[ -z "$LG_OK" ]]; then
    mios_warn "Looking-glass-client build failed after 3 attempts"
    exit 1
fi

record_version looking-glass "$LG_VERSION" "https://github.com/gnif/LookingGlass/commit/${LG_SHA}"
# Build output, not SSOT: the commit this client speaks, so the guest IDD is fetched for the same one.
install -Dm0644 /dev/stdin "$LG_RECORD" <<JSON
{
  "ref": "$LG_REF",
  "commit": "$LG_SHA",
  "version": "$LG_VERSION",
  "repo": "$LG_REPO",
  "built_at": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
}
JSON
mios_log "Looking Glass $LG_VERSION ($LG_SHA) recorded in $LG_RECORD"

install -Dm0644 /dev/stdin "$DESTDIR/usr/share/applications/looking-glass.desktop" <<'DESK'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Looking Glass
Comment=Low-latency KVM display from a VM via shared memory
Icon=video-display
Exec=looking-glass-client
Terminal=false
Categories=System;Utility;
Keywords=KVM;VFIO;Passthrough;
DESK

mios_log "Cleanup source tree"
cd /
rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"

mios_ok "Looking-glass-client $LG_VERSION baked in at $LG_BIN"

entries.title: 70-bake-wayvnc-upstream.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Builds wayvnc + neatvnc + aml from the latest upstream default-branch HEADs (no pins; the resolved commits are recorded in build output /usr/libexec/mios/wayvnc/build.json) and installs a self-contained wayvnc (neatvnc/aml linked statically) to /usr/libexec/mios/wayvnc/wayvnc. The RDP bridge prefers it over Fedora's /usr/bin/wayvnc: the Fedora-packaged release exits on any cursor-capture failure ("Fatal error while capturing", main.c:1591), which Hyprland 0.56 produces when the pointer is on a scaled output; upstream keeps running without the cursor image.
# AI-related: /usr/libexec/mios/mios-rdp-rfb-bridge, /usr/libexec/mios/mios-rdp, /usr/share/mios/mios.toml [remote.rdp].wayvnc_binary [packages.wayvnc-build]
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/lib/common.sh"
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/lib/packages.sh"

# MIOS_WAYVNC_DESTDIR stages the install under another root (a dev-container build copied onto a running
# host); empty for the image build. MIOS_WAYVNC_JOBS caps ninja's parallelism.
DESTDIR="${MIOS_WAYVNC_DESTDIR:-}"
OUT_DIR="$DESTDIR/usr/libexec/mios/wayvnc"
BUILD_DIR="${MIOS_WAYVNC_BUILD_DIR:-/tmp/wayvnc-upstream-build}"
declare -A REPO=(
    [wayvnc]="https://github.com/any1/wayvnc.git"
    [neatvnc]="https://github.com/any1/neatvnc.git"
    [aml]="https://github.com/any1/aml.git"
)

# "latest" floats with upstream: each repo's default-branch HEAD, resolved now, never pinned.
declare -A SHA=()
for p in wayvnc neatvnc aml; do
    SHA[$p]="$(git ls-remote "${REPO[$p]}" HEAD | awk '{print $1; exit}')" || true
    [[ "${SHA[$p]}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || die "wayvnc-upstream: HEAD of ${REPO[$p]} could not be resolved"
    mios_log "wayvnc-upstream: $p HEAD resolves to ${SHA[$p]}"
done

if [[ -x "$OUT_DIR/wayvnc" && -r "$OUT_DIR/build.json" ]] \
   && python3 -I - "$OUT_DIR/build.json" "${SHA[wayvnc]}" "${SHA[neatvnc]}" "${SHA[aml]}" <<'PY'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
sys.exit(0 if [d[p]["commit"] for p in ("wayvnc", "neatvnc", "aml")] == sys.argv[2:5] else 1)
PY
then
    mios_ok "wayvnc-upstream already built from ${SHA[wayvnc]:0:12} (neatvnc ${SHA[neatvnc]:0:12}, aml ${SHA[aml]:0:12})"
    exit 0
fi

[[ "${MIOS_WAYVNC_SKIP_DEPS:-0}" == 1 ]] || install_packages "wayvnc-build"
MISSING=""
for tool in meson ninja gcc git pkg-config; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING="${MISSING}${tool} "
done
[[ -z "$MISSING" ]] || { mios_skip "missing toolchain: $MISSING"; exit 0; }

cd /
rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"
mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR"
fetch() {  # fetch <name> <dir>: exactly the resolved commit
    local p="$1" d="$2"
    git init -q "$d"
    git -C "$d" fetch -q --depth 1 "${REPO[$p]}" "${SHA[$p]}"
    git -C "$d" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
    [[ "$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD)" == "${SHA[$p]}" ]] || die "wayvnc-upstream: $p checkout is not ${SHA[$p]}"
}
fetch wayvnc "$BUILD_DIR/wayvnc"
mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/wayvnc/subprojects"
fetch neatvnc "$BUILD_DIR/wayvnc/subprojects/neatvnc"
fetch aml "$BUILD_DIR/wayvnc/subprojects/aml"

cd "$BUILD_DIR/wayvnc"
# neatvnc/aml as static subprojects: the binary depends only on Fedora's system libraries.
meson setup build --buildtype=release --prefix=/usr/libexec/mios/wayvnc \
    -Ddefault_library=static -Dman-pages=disabled -Dtests=false \
    -Dneatvnc:examples=false -Dneatvnc:benchmarks=false -Dneatvnc:tests=false
ninja -C build -j"${MIOS_WAYVNC_JOBS:-$(nproc)}" wayvnc
VERSION="$(./build/wayvnc --version 2>&1 | head -1)"
[[ -n "$VERSION" ]] || die "wayvnc-upstream: built binary does not run"
if ldd ./build/wayvnc | grep -Eq 'libneatvnc|libaml|not found'; then
    die "wayvnc-upstream: binary still links neatvnc/aml dynamically or misses a library: $(ldd ./build/wayvnc | grep -E 'libneatvnc|libaml|not found')"
fi

install -d -m 0755 "$OUT_DIR"
install -m 0755 ./build/wayvnc "$OUT_DIR/wayvnc.new"
mv -f "$OUT_DIR/wayvnc.new" "$OUT_DIR/wayvnc"
# Build output, not SSOT: the commits this binary was built from.
python3 -I - "$OUT_DIR/build.json" "$VERSION" <<PY
import json, os, sys, time
rec = {
    "version": sys.argv[2],
    "built_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
    "wayvnc": {"repo": "${REPO[wayvnc]}", "commit": "${SHA[wayvnc]}"},
    "neatvnc": {"repo": "${REPO[neatvnc]}", "commit": "${SHA[neatvnc]}"},
    "aml": {"repo": "${REPO[aml]}", "commit": "${SHA[aml]}"},
}
tmp = sys.argv[1] + ".new"
with open(tmp, "w") as f:
    json.dump(rec, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.chmod(tmp, 0o644)
os.replace(tmp, sys.argv[1])
PY
if command -v record_version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    record_version wayvnc-upstream "$VERSION" "${REPO[wayvnc]%.git}/commit/${SHA[wayvnc]}" || true
fi
mios_ok "wayvnc-upstream $VERSION -> $OUT_DIR/wayvnc (wayvnc ${SHA[wayvnc]}, neatvnc ${SHA[neatvnc]}, aml ${SHA[aml]})"
cd /
rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"

entries.title: 71-bake-rdp-server.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Builds the MiOS native RDP server (src/mios-rdp-server: mios-rdp-server + mios-rdp-priv) against IronRDP's default-branch HEAD, resolved now and never pinned (the resolved commit, the generated Cargo.lock hash and the enabled features are build output in /usr/libexec/mios/rdp-native/build.json and the SBOM), and installs it to /usr/libexec/mios/rdp-native/. Documented static-policy exceptions (rdp-native-design.md 12): both binaries are x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, dynamically linked (E1 mios-rdp-server: libEGL/libgbm/libxkbcommon + dlopen of the Cisco libopenh264; E2 mios-rdp-priv: libpam). If the build fails nothing is installed (image) or the last good binary stays (MIOS_RDP_DESTDIR host/dev builds), and [remote.rdp].server = "native" falls back to xrdp.
# AI-related: /usr/libexec/mios/mios-rdp, /usr/lib/systemd/user/mios-rdp-native.service, /usr/lib/systemd/system/mios-rdp-priv.socket, /usr/share/mios/mios.toml [remote.rdp] [remote.rdp.native] [packages.rdp-server-build], src/mios-rdp-server/
# AI-doc: usr/share/doc/mios/manual/automation.md
set -euo pipefail
umask 0022
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/common.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/packages.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
# shellcheck source=automation/lib/upstream-latest.sh
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/upstream-latest.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
command -v mios_log >/dev/null || mios_log() { printf '[71-bake-rdp-server] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
command -v mios_ok >/dev/null || mios_ok() { mios_log "OK: $*"; }
command -v mios_err >/dev/null || mios_err() { mios_log "ERROR: $*"; }

get() { MIOS_TOML_ROOT="$ROOT_DIR" python3 "$ROOT_DIR/usr/libexec/mios/mios-toml-get" --vendor "$@"; }

DESTDIR="${MIOS_RDP_DESTDIR:-}"
OUT_DIR="$DESTDIR/usr/libexec/mios/rdp-native"
BUILD_DIR="${MIOS_RDP_BUILD_DIR:-/tmp/mios-rdp-server-build}"
URL="${MIOS_URL_IRONRDP:-https://github.com/Devolutions/IronRDP.git}"
SRC="$ROOT_DIR/src/mios-rdp-server"
[[ -f "$SRC/Cargo.toml" ]] || { mios_err "src/mios-rdp-server missing"; exit 1; }

# "latest" floats with upstream: IronRDP's default-branch HEAD, resolved now, never pinned.
SHA="$(git ls-remote "$URL" HEAD | awk '{print $1; exit}')" || true
[[ "$SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { mios_err "IronRDP HEAD of $URL could not be resolved"; exit 1; }
SRC_HASH="$(cd "$SRC" && find . -type f \( -name '*.rs' -o -name '*.toml' \) -not -path './target/*' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
mios_log "IronRDP HEAD resolves to $SHA; MiOS source ${SRC_HASH:0:12}"

if [[ "${MIOS_RDP_FORCE:-0}" != 1 && -x "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-server" && -r "$OUT_DIR/build.json" ]] \
   && python3 -I - "$OUT_DIR/build.json" "$SHA" "$SRC_HASH" <<'PY'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
sys.exit(0 if d.get("ironrdp", {}).get("commit") == sys.argv[2] and d.get("source_sha256") == sys.argv[3] else 1)
PY
then
    mios_ok "mios-rdp-server already built from IronRDP ${SHA:0:12} / source ${SRC_HASH:0:12}"
    exit 0
fi

if [[ "${MIOS_RDP_SKIP_DEPS:-0}" != 1 ]] && command -v install_packages >/dev/null; then
    install_packages "rdp-server-build" || mios_log "rdp-server-build packages not installable here; using what is present"
fi

rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"
mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR"

# Hermetic linker stubs for dynamic dependencies when -devel packages are absent
STUB_DIR="$BUILD_DIR/linker-stubs"
mkdir -p "$STUB_DIR"
if [[ ! -e /usr/lib64/libgbm.so && -e /usr/lib64/libgbm.so.1 ]]; then
    ln -sf /usr/lib64/libgbm.so.1 "$STUB_DIR/libgbm.so"
fi
if [[ ! -e /usr/lib64/libpam.so && -e /usr/lib64/libpam.so.0 ]]; then
    ln -sf /usr/lib64/libpam.so.0 "$STUB_DIR/libpam.so"
fi
if ! pkg-config --exists gbm 2>/dev/null && [[ -e /usr/lib64/libgbm.so.1 ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/pkgconfig"
    cat << 'EOF_PC' > "$BUILD_DIR/pkgconfig/gbm.pc"
prefix=/usr
libdir=/usr/lib64
includedir=/usr/include

Name: gbm
Description: Generic Buffer Management
Version: 26.2.4
Libs: -L${libdir} -lgbm
Cflags: -I${includedir}
EOF_PC
    export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="${BUILD_DIR}/pkgconfig:${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:-}"
fi

MISSING=""
for tool in git pkg-config cc; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING="${MISSING}${tool} "; done
for pc in egl gbm xkbcommon; do pkg-config --exists "$pc" 2>/dev/null || MISSING="${MISSING}${pc}.pc "; done
[[ -z "$MISSING" ]] || { mios_err "missing build dependencies: $MISSING"; exit 1; }

export RUSTUP_HOME="${RUSTUP_HOME:-$(get build.toolchain rustup_home 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/lib/mios/rustup)}"
export CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$(get build.toolchain cargo_home 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/lib/mios/cargo)}"
if [[ ! -d "${CARGO_HOME}" && -d /root/.cargo ]]; then
    export CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo
elif [[ ! -d "${CARGO_HOME}" && -d /home/mios/.cargo ]]; then
    export CARGO_HOME=/home/mios/.cargo
fi
if [[ ! -d "${RUSTUP_HOME}" && -d /root/.rustup ]]; then
    export RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup
elif [[ ! -d "${RUSTUP_HOME}" && -d /home/mios/.rustup ]]; then
    export RUSTUP_HOME=/home/mios/.rustup
fi
export PATH="${CARGO_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"
export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN="${RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN:-$(get build.toolchain channel 2>/dev/null || echo stable)}"
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS="${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS:-4}"
export RUSTFLAGS="-L ${STUB_DIR} ${RUSTFLAGS:-}"
TARGET=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

if [[ -d /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp/.git ]] \
   && [[ "$(git -C /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" == "$SHA" ]] \
   && [[ -z "$(git -C /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp status --porcelain 2>/dev/null || echo dirty)" ]]; then
    cp -a /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp "$BUILD_DIR/ironrdp"
else
    git init -q "$BUILD_DIR/ironrdp"
    git -C "$BUILD_DIR/ironrdp" fetch -q --depth 1 "$URL" "$SHA"
    git -C "$BUILD_DIR/ironrdp" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
fi
[[ "$(git -C "$BUILD_DIR/ironrdp" rev-parse HEAD)" == "$SHA" ]] || { mios_err "IronRDP checkout is not $SHA"; exit 1; }
cp -a "$SRC" "$BUILD_DIR/src"
rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR/src/target" "$BUILD_DIR/src/Cargo.lock"
if [[ -z "$DESTDIR" ]]; then
    mkdir -p /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native
    rm -rf /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp
    cp -a "$BUILD_DIR/ironrdp" /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp
    chown -R 1000:1000 /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp 2>/dev/null || true
    chmod -R u+rwX,go+rX /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp
    ln -sfn /var/lib/mios-build/rdp-native/ironrdp "$ROOT_DIR/src/ironrdp"
fi

(cd "$BUILD_DIR/src" && cargo build --release --target "$TARGET" -p mios-rdp-server -p mios-rdp-priv)
(cd "$BUILD_DIR/src" && cargo test --release --target "$TARGET" -p mios-rdp-server -p mios-rdp-priv)
BIN="$BUILD_DIR/src/target/$TARGET/release"
LOCK_HASH="$(sha256sum "$BUILD_DIR/src/Cargo.lock" | awk '{print $1}')"
SELF="$("$BIN/mios-rdp-server" --self-test 2>/dev/null | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
print(json.dumps({"openh264": d.get("openh264", {}).get("ok"), "egl": d.get("egl", {}).get("ok")}))' 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')"

install -d -m 0755 "$OUT_DIR"
install -m 0755 "$BIN/mios-rdp-server" "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-server.new"
install -m 0755 "$BIN/mios-rdp-priv" "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-priv.new"
mv -f "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-server.new" "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-server"
mv -f "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-priv.new" "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-priv"

# Install canonical tracked PAM file
install -d -m 0755 "${DESTDIR}/usr/lib/pam.d"
if [[ -f "${ROOT_DIR}/usr/lib/pam.d/mios-rdp" ]]; then
    pam_src="$(realpath -m "${ROOT_DIR}/usr/lib/pam.d/mios-rdp")"
    pam_dst="$(realpath -m "${DESTDIR}/usr/lib/pam.d/mios-rdp")"
    if [[ "$pam_dst" != "$pam_src" ]]; then
        install -m 0644 "${pam_src}" "${pam_dst}"
    else
        chmod 0644 "${pam_src}"
    fi
    install -d -m 0755 "${DESTDIR}/etc/pam.d"
    pam_etc="$(realpath -m "${DESTDIR}/etc/pam.d/mios-rdp")"
    install -m 0644 "${pam_src}" "${pam_etc}"
fi

python3 -I - "$OUT_DIR/build.json" "$URL" "$SHA" "$SRC_HASH" "$LOCK_HASH" "$SELF" "$("$BIN/mios-rdp-server" --version 2>/dev/null || echo mios-rdp-server)" "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-server" "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-priv" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys, time, hashlib
out, url, sha, src, lock, selftest, ver, srv_path, priv_path = sys.argv[1:10]

def file_sha256(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        while chunk := f.read(65536):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

rec = {
    "built_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
    "version": ver,
    "ironrdp": {"repo": url, "commit": sha},
    "source_sha256": src,
    "cargo_lock_sha256": lock,
    "target": "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
    "features": ["egfx", "helper", "nscodec"],
    "static_policy_exceptions": ["E1 mios-rdp-server glibc dynamic (EGL, GBM, xkbcommon, dlopen libopenh264)",
                                 "E2 mios-rdp-priv glibc + libpam"],
    "self_test": json.loads(selftest or "{}"),
    "binaries": {
        "mios-rdp-server": file_sha256(srv_path),
        "mios-rdp-priv": file_sha256(priv_path),
    },
}
tmp = out + ".new"
with open(tmp, "w") as f:
    json.dump(rec, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.chmod(tmp, 0o644)
os.replace(tmp, out)
PY
if command -v mios_record_resolved >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mios_record_resolved mios-rdp-server "ironrdp-${SHA:0:12}" "${URL%.git}/commit/${SHA}" "$(sha256sum "$OUT_DIR/mios-rdp-server" | awk '{print $1}')" || true
fi
mios_ok "mios-rdp-server -> $OUT_DIR (IronRDP $SHA, self-test $SELF)"
cd /
rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"

entries.title: 72-hermes-agent.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/bin/bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=universal
# AI-hint: Installs the unified Hermes-Agent and opencode components into the MiOS agent plane, configuring the shared Python venv, sy...
# AI-doc: usr/share/doc/mios/manual/automation.md
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null  # Resolve the repository or installed FHS logging library.
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done

source "$(dirname "$0")/lib/common.sh" 2>/dev/null || {
    mios_warn "Lib/common.sh unavailable"
    exit 0
}
source "$(dirname "$0")/lib/packages.sh"

HERMES_REPO="${MIOS_HERMES_AGENT_REPO:-https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git}"
HERMES_REF="${MIOS_HERMES_AGENT_REF:-main}"
AGENTS_ROOT=/usr/lib/mios/agents
VENV_ROOT="${MIOS_HERMES_DIR:-${AGENTS_ROOT}/hermes-agent}"   # Hermes vendor code (FHS /usr/lib)
VENV_DIR="${MIOS_HERMES_VENV:-${AGENTS_ROOT}/.venv}"          # shared interpreter (sibling)
BIN_DIR="${VENV_ROOT}/bin"

CONSTRAINTS_FILE="${MIOS_HERMES_CONSTRAINTS:-/usr/share/mios/agents/constraints.txt}"
PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG=""
if [[ -f "$CONSTRAINTS_FILE" ]]; then
    PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG="-c ${CONSTRAINTS_FILE}"
else
    mios_warn "Pip constraints ${CONSTRAINTS_FILE} absent"
fi

mios_log "Direct install: repo=${HERMES_REPO} ref=${HERMES_REF} constraints=${PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG:-none}"

_missing=""
for tool in python3 git; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || _missing="${_missing} ${tool}"
done
if [[ -n "$_missing" ]]; then
    mios_warn "Missing build tools:${_missing}"
    exit 0
fi

install -d -m 0755 "${AGENTS_ROOT}" "${VENV_ROOT}" "${BIN_DIR}" || { mios_warn "Mkdir ${VENV_ROOT} failed"; exit 0; }

VENV_PY=python3
for _py in python3.13 python3.12 python3.11; do
    command -v "${_py}" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { VENV_PY="${_py}"; break; }
done
mios_log "Venv interpreter: ${VENV_PY})"
if ! "${VENV_PY}" -m venv "${VENV_DIR}" 2>/dev/null; then
    mios_warn "${VENV_PY} -m venv failed"
    exit 0
fi
if [ -x "${VENV_DIR}/bin/${VENV_PY}" ]; then
    ln -sf "${VENV_PY}" "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python3" 2>/dev/null || true
    ln -sf "${VENV_PY}" "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

PIP_OFFLINE_ARGS=""
LOCAL_SOURCE=""
if [ -d "/usr/share/mios/vendored/hermes-agent" ]; then
    mios_log "Found offline vendored hermes-agent directory"
    LOCAL_SOURCE="/usr/share/mios/vendored/hermes-agent"
elif [ -f "/usr/share/mios/vendored/hermes-agent.zip" ]; then
    mios_log "Found offline vendored hermes-agent.zip, extracting"
    unzip -o -q /usr/share/mios/vendored/hermes-agent.zip -d /tmp/hermes-agent-src 2>/dev/null || true
    LOCAL_SOURCE="/tmp/hermes-agent-src/hermes-agent"
elif [ -f "/usr/share/mios/vendored/hermes_agent.whl" ]; then
    mios_log "Found offline vendored hermes_agent.whl"
    LOCAL_SOURCE="/usr/share/mios/vendored/hermes_agent.whl"
elif [ -f "/usr/share/mios/vendored/wheels/hermes_agent.tar.gz" ]; then
    mios_log "Found offline vendored hermes_agent.tar.gz, extracting"
    rm -rf /tmp/hermes-agent-src
    mkdir -p /tmp/hermes-agent-src
    # tar's exit status is not the test: it returns non-zero for benign
    # per-entry warnings while still unpacking the tree. Judge on the result.
    tar -xzf /usr/share/mios/vendored/wheels/hermes_agent.tar.gz \
        -C /tmp/hermes-agent-src 2>/dev/null || true
    # Take whatever single top-level directory the archive unpacked to, rather
    # than hardcoding the upstream's branch-derived name (hermes-agent-main).
    for _cand in /tmp/hermes-agent-src/*/; do
        [ -f "${_cand}pyproject.toml" ] || [ -f "${_cand}setup.py" ] || continue
        LOCAL_SOURCE="${_cand%/}"
        break
    done
    [ -n "$LOCAL_SOURCE" ] \
        || mios_warn "hermes_agent.tar.gz unusable: no python project root after extract"
fi

if [ -n "$LOCAL_SOURCE" ]; then
    PIP_OFFLINE_ARGS="--no-index --find-links=/usr/share/mios/vendored/wheels/"
    INSTALL_TARGET="-e $LOCAL_SOURCE"
else
    # No usable vendored source. That is fine for an online build, but on an
    # offline/air-gapped build the clone below cannot succeed, and failing
    # quietly is what let the broken vendored asset go unnoticed.
    if [[ "${MIOS_ONLINE_BUILD:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
        mios_warn "OFFLINE build found no usable vendored hermes-agent source" \
                  "(checked vendored/hermes-agent{,.zip}, hermes_agent.whl," \
                  "wheels/hermes_agent.tar.gz) -- falling back to a network clone"
    fi
    if [ ! -d "${VENV_ROOT}/.git" ]; then
        mios_log "Cloning ${HERMES_REPO} to ${VENV_ROOT}"
        rm -rf "${VENV_ROOT}"
        git clone --depth 1 --branch "${HERMES_REF}" "${HERMES_REPO}" "${VENV_ROOT}" 2>/dev/null || \
            git clone "${HERMES_REPO}" "${VENV_ROOT}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    INSTALL_TARGET="-e ${VENV_ROOT}"
    if [ -d "/usr/share/mios/vendored/wheels" ]; then
        PIP_OFFLINE_ARGS="--find-links=/usr/share/mios/vendored/wheels/"
        if [[ "${MIOS_ONLINE_BUILD:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
            PIP_OFFLINE_ARGS="--no-index --find-links=/usr/share/mios/vendored/wheels/"
        fi
    fi
fi

"${VENV_DIR}/bin/pip" install --no-input --disable-pip-version-check setuptools wheel 2>/dev/null || true

_REQ_ARGS=()
_REQ_FILES="$(get_package_list_setting ai python_requirements)"
[[ -n "${_REQ_FILES// }" ]] || { mios_err "[packages.ai].python_requirements is empty"; exit 1; }
for _req in ${_REQ_FILES}; do
    _req="/${_req#/}"
    [[ -f "$_req" ]] || { mios_err "Missing agent runtime requirements: $_req"; exit 1; }
    _REQ_ARGS+=(-r "$_req")
done
_venv_pip_ok=""
_PIP_ARGS_ONLINE="${PIP_OFFLINE_ARGS//--no-index/}"
for _venv_attempt in 1 2 3; do
    _pa="${PIP_OFFLINE_ARGS}"
    [ "${_venv_attempt}" -ge 2 ] && _pa="${_PIP_ARGS_ONLINE}"
    if "${VENV_DIR}/bin/pip" install --no-input --disable-pip-version-check --ignore-requires-python --no-build-isolation ${_pa} ${PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG} \
            ${INSTALL_TARGET} "${_REQ_ARGS[@]}" \
            aiohttp websockets "discord.py>=2.4,<3" "psycopg[binary]" "firecrawl-py" \
            "smolagents>=1.0.0" "litellm>=1.0.0" "mcp>=2.1.1,<3" 2>&1 | tail -8; then
        _venv_pip_ok=1; break
    fi
    if [ "${_venv_attempt}" -eq 1 ]; then
        mios_warn "Agent-venv offline install incomplete"
    else
        mios_warn "Agent-venv pip install attempt ${_venv_attempt}/3 failed"
    fi
    sleep $((_venv_attempt*8))
done
if [ -z "${_venv_pip_ok}" ]; then
    mios_err "Agent-venv pip install failed after 3 attempts"
    rm -rf "${VENV_DIR}"
    exit 1
fi

if [[ -x "${VENV_DIR}/bin/hermes" ]]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "${BIN_DIR}"
    ln -sf "${VENV_DIR}/bin/hermes" "${BIN_DIR}/hermes"
    mios_ok "Installed ${VENV_DIR}/bin/hermes -> ${BIN_DIR}/hermes"
    record_version "hermes-agent" "${HERMES_REF}" "$(${VENV_DIR}/bin/hermes --version 2>&1 | head -1)" 2>/dev/null || true
else
    mios_err "Pip succeeded but no 'hermes' entry-point in venv"
    exit 1
fi

shopt -s nullglob
for site_packages in "${VENV_DIR}/lib/"python*/site-packages; do
    searxng_dir="${site_packages}/plugins/web/searxng"
    if [[ -d "$searxng_dir" && ! -f "${searxng_dir}/plugin.yaml" ]]; then
        cat > "${searxng_dir}/plugin.yaml" <<YAML
name: searxng
kind: backend
version: ${MIOS_VERSION:-Unknown}
description: SearXNG web-search provider (local self-hosted instance at mios-searxng:8888).
register: plugins.web.searxng:register
YAML
        mios_ok "Seeded ${searxng_dir#${VENV_DIR}/}/plugin.yaml"
    fi
    firecrawl_dir="${site_packages}/plugins/web/firecrawl"
    if [[ -d "$firecrawl_dir" && ! -f "${firecrawl_dir}/plugin.yaml" ]]; then
        cat > "${firecrawl_dir}/plugin.yaml" <<YAML
name: firecrawl
kind: backend
version: ${MIOS_VERSION:-Unknown}
description: Firecrawl web provider (self-hosted at FIRECRAWL_API_URL; DORMANT -- SDK v2 vs container v1 mismatch, web.extract_backend defaults to miosfetch).
register: plugins.web.firecrawl:register
YAML
        mios_ok "Seeded ${firecrawl_dir#${VENV_DIR}/}/plugin.yaml"
    fi
    _mf_src="/usr/share/mios/hermes/plugins/web/miosfetch"
    _mf_dst="${site_packages}/plugins/web/miosfetch"
    if [[ -d "$_mf_src" ]]; then
        install -d "$_mf_dst"
        cp -f "$_mf_src"/provider.py "$_mf_src"/__init__.py "$_mf_src"/plugin.yaml "$_mf_dst"/ 2>/dev/null \
            && mios_ok "Deployed miosfetch plugin -> ${_mf_dst#${VENV_DIR}/}"
    fi
    _wt="${site_packages}/tools/web_tools.py"
    if [[ -f "$_wt" ]] && ! grep -q 'backend == "miosfetch"' "$_wt"; then
        sed -i 's/^    if backend == "exa":/    if backend == "miosfetch":  # MiOS offline direct-fetch provider (stdlib; always usable)\n        return True\n    if backend == "exa":/' "$_wt" \
            && mios_ok "Patched web_tools._is_backend_available for miosfetch"
    fi
done
shopt -u nullglob

if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    DASH_TMP=$(mktemp -d)
    if (cd "$DASH_TMP" && git archive --remote="${HERMES_REPO}" "${HERMES_REF}" plugins 2>/dev/null | tar -x 2>/dev/null) ||
       git clone --depth 1 --branch "${HERMES_REF}" --filter=blob:none --sparse "${HERMES_REPO}" "$DASH_TMP/repo" 2>&1 | tail -3 &&
       (cd "$DASH_TMP/repo" && git sparse-checkout set plugins 2>/dev/null) ; then
        DASH_SRC="$DASH_TMP/plugins"
        [[ -d "$DASH_TMP/repo/plugins" ]] && DASH_SRC="$DASH_TMP/repo/plugins"
        shopt -s nullglob
        for site_packages in "${VENV_DIR}/lib/"python*/site-packages; do
            for plugin_name in kanban example-dashboard hermes-achievements; do
                src_dash="$DASH_SRC/$plugin_name/dashboard"
                dst_dash="$site_packages/plugins/$plugin_name/dashboard"
                if [[ -d "$src_dash" && -d "$dst_dash" ]]; then
                    [[ -f "$src_dash/manifest.json" && ! -f "$dst_dash/manifest.json" ]] && \
                        cp "$src_dash/manifest.json" "$dst_dash/manifest.json"
                    if [[ -d "$src_dash/dist" ]]; then
                        mkdir -p "$dst_dash/dist"
                        cp -n "$src_dash/dist/"*.{js,css} "$dst_dash/dist/" 2>/dev/null || true
                    fi
                fi
            done
        done
        shopt -u nullglob
        rm -rf "$DASH_TMP"
        mios_ok "Seeded plugins/{kanban,example-dashboard,hermes-achievements}/dashboard/{manifest.json,dist}"
    else
        mios_warn "Could not fetch upstream dashboard manifests; kanban tab will not appear"
        rm -rf "$DASH_TMP"
    fi
fi

if ! "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python3" -c "import fastapi, uvicorn, ptyprocess" 2>/dev/null; then
    if "${VENV_DIR}/bin/pip" install --no-input --disable-pip-version-check ${PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG} \
            "fastapi>=0.110" "uvicorn[standard]>=0.30" "python-multipart" "ptyprocess>=0.7" 2>&1 | tail -3; then
        mios_ok "Installed fastapi + uvicorn + ptyprocess into venv"
    else
        mios_warn "Dashboard runtime deps install failed"
    fi
fi

if ! "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python3" -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert int(version('mcp').split('.')[0]) >= 2" 2>/dev/null; then
    if "${VENV_DIR}/bin/pip" install --no-input --disable-pip-version-check ${PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG} "mcp>=2.1.1,<3" 2>&1 | tail -3; then
        mios_ok "Installed mcp SDK into venv"
    else
        mios_warn "Mcp SDK install failed"
    fi
fi

TOK_BACKEND="${MIOS_TOKENIZER_BACKEND:-}"
TOK_ENCODING="${MIOS_TOKENIZER_ENCODING:-}"
TOK_CACHE_DIR="${MIOS_TOKENIZER_CACHE_DIR:-}"
if [[ "$TOK_BACKEND" == "tiktoken" ]]; then
    if ! "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python3" -c "import tiktoken" 2>/dev/null; then
        if "${VENV_DIR}/bin/pip" install --no-input --disable-pip-version-check ${PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG} "tiktoken>=0.7" 2>&1 | tail -3; then
            mios_ok "Installed tiktoken into the agent venv"
        else
            mios_warn "Tiktoken install failed"
        fi
    fi
    if [[ -n "$TOK_ENCODING" && -n "$TOK_CACHE_DIR" ]] && "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python3" -c "import tiktoken" 2>/dev/null; then
        mkdir -p "$TOK_CACHE_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
        if TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR="$TOK_CACHE_DIR" "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python3" \
                -c "import sys, tiktoken; tiktoken.get_encoding(sys.argv[1])" "$TOK_ENCODING" 2>&1 | tail -2; then
            mios_ok "Pre-warmed tiktoken encoding ${TOK_ENCODING} into ${TOK_CACHE_DIR}"
        else
            mios_warn "Tiktoken encoding pre-warm failed"
        fi
    fi
fi

if ! "${VENV_DIR}/bin/python3" -c "import smolagents, litellm" 2>/dev/null; then
    if "${VENV_DIR}/bin/pip" install --no-input --disable-pip-version-check ${PIP_CONSTRAINTS_ARG} \
            "smolagents>=1.0.0" "litellm>=1.0.0" 2>&1 | tail -3; then
        mios_ok "Installed smolagents + litellm into the agent venv"
    else
        mios_warn "Smolagents + litellm install failed"
    fi
fi

_BUILD_SPA() {
    command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { mios_warn "Node not installed"; return 1; }
    command -v npm  >/dev/null 2>&1 || { mios_warn "Npm not installed"; return 1; }
    command -v git  >/dev/null 2>&1 || { mios_warn "Git not installed"; return 1; }

    local spa_tmp
    spa_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
    if ! git clone --depth 1 --branch "${HERMES_REF}" "${HERMES_REPO}" "$spa_tmp/repo" 2>&1 | tail -3 ; then
        mios_warn "SPA: clone failed"
        rm -rf "$spa_tmp"; return 1
    fi

    if ! (cd "$spa_tmp/repo/web" && npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3); then
        mios_warn "SPA: npm install failed"
        rm -rf "$spa_tmp"; return 1
    fi

    if ! (cd "$spa_tmp/repo/web" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8); then
        mios_warn "SPA: npm run build failed"
        rm -rf "$spa_tmp"; return 1
    fi

    local built="$spa_tmp/repo/hermes_cli/web_dist"
    if [[ ! -f "$built/index.html" ]]; then
        mios_warn "SPA: build produced no index.html at $built"
        rm -rf "$spa_tmp"; return 1
    fi

    local strip_helper="${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}/support/hermes-dashboard-strip-externals.py"
    if [[ -x "$strip_helper" || -f "$strip_helper" ]]; then
        if ! python3 "$strip_helper" "$built" ; then
            mios_warn "SPA: strip-externals reported leftover external refs"
            rm -rf "$spa_tmp"; return 1
        fi
    else
        mios_warn "SPA: strip-externals helper missing at $strip_helper"
        rm -rf "$spa_tmp"; return 1
    fi

    shopt -s nullglob
    for site_packages in "${VENV_DIR}/lib/"python*/site-packages; do
        local dst="$site_packages/hermes_cli/web_dist"
        rm -rf "$dst"
        mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dst")"
        cp -r "$built" "$dst"
        mios_ok "SPA: installed $(du -sh "$dst" | cut -f1) to ${dst#${VENV_DIR}/}"
    done
    shopt -u nullglob

    rm -rf "$spa_tmp"
    return 0
}

_BUILD_SPA || mios_warn "Dashboard SPA not built; hermes-dashboard.service will fall back to the web_dist_stub"

_VENDOR_OPENUI="${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}/support/mios-vendor-openui.sh"
if [[ -x "$_VENDOR_OPENUI" || -f "$_VENDOR_OPENUI" ]]; then
    bash "$_VENDOR_OPENUI" || mios_warn "OpenUI bundle download failed; render panel will report 'bundle missing' until re-run"
else
    mios_warn "Mios-vendor-openui.sh missing at $_VENDOR_OPENUI"
fi

_PTY_PATCH="${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}/support/hermes-dashboard-shell-patch.py"
shopt -s nullglob
for site_packages in "${VENV_DIR}/lib/"python*/site-packages; do
    _ws="$site_packages/hermes_cli/web_server.py"
    if [[ -f "$_ws" && -f "$_PTY_PATCH" ]]; then
        if python3 "$_PTY_PATCH" "$_ws" 2>&1 | tail -2; then
            : # ok; idempotent — re-runs are no-ops once marker present
        else
            mios_warn "HERMES_PTY_SHELL patch failed on $_ws"
        fi
    fi
done
shopt -u nullglob

_BGREVIEW_PATCH="${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}/support/hermes-background-review-tools-patch.py"
shopt -s nullglob
for site_packages in "${VENV_DIR}/lib/"python*/site-packages; do
    _br="$site_packages/agent/background_review.py"
    if [[ -f "$_br" && -f "$_BGREVIEW_PATCH" ]]; then
        if python3 "$_BGREVIEW_PATCH" "$_br" 2>&1 | tail -2; then
            : # ok; idempotent -- re-runs are no-ops once marker present
        else
            mios_warn "Background-review tool patch failed on $_br"
        fi
    fi
done
shopt -u nullglob

OPENCODE_VERSION="${MIOS_OPENCODE_VERSION:-latest}"
OPENCODE_INSTALL_URL="${MIOS_OPENCODE_INSTALL_URL:-https://opencode.ai/install}"
OPENCODE_BIN="${MIOS_OPENCODE_BIN:-/usr/lib/mios/agents/opencode/bin/opencode}"
OPENCODE_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "${OPENCODE_BIN}")"
OPENCODE_ROOT="$(dirname "${OPENCODE_BIN_DIR}")"
OPENCODE_CONFIG="${MIOS_OPENCODE_CONFIG:-/etc/mios/opencode/opencode.json}"
OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR="$(dirname "${OPENCODE_CONFIG}")"
OPENCODE_VENDOR_CONFIG=/usr/share/mios/opencode/opencode.json

mios_log "Opencode phase: version=${OPENCODE_VERSION} root=${OPENCODE_ROOT}"

if [[ -f "${OPENCODE_VENDOR_CONFIG}" ]]; then
    if install -d -m 0750 "${OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR}" 2>/dev/null; then
        if [[ ! -f "${OPENCODE_CONFIG}" ]]; then
            if install -m 0640 "${OPENCODE_VENDOR_CONFIG}" "${OPENCODE_CONFIG}"; then
                if getent group mios-ai >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                    chgrp mios-ai "${OPENCODE_CONFIG}" 2>/dev/null \
                        && chmod 0640 "${OPENCODE_CONFIG}" 2>/dev/null || true
                fi
                mios_ok "Landed opencode.json -> ${OPENCODE_CONFIG}"
            else
                mios_warn "Failed to land opencode.json into ${OPENCODE_CONFIG}"
            fi
        else
            mios_skip "${OPENCODE_CONFIG} already present (admin override) -- not overwriting"
        fi
    else
        mios_warn "Could not create ${OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR}"
    fi
else
    mios_warn "Vendored ${OPENCODE_VENDOR_CONFIG} missing"
fi

_oc_missing=""
for tool in curl bash; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || _oc_missing="${_oc_missing} ${tool}"
done
if [[ -n "$_oc_missing" ]]; then
    mios_warn "Opencode phase: missing tools:${_oc_missing}"
elif [[ -x "${OPENCODE_BIN}" ]]; then
    mios_skip "opencode binary already present at ${OPENCODE_BIN} -- skipping fetch"
elif ! install -d -m 0755 "${OPENCODE_ROOT}" "${OPENCODE_BIN_DIR}" 2>/dev/null; then
    mios_warn "Mkdir ${OPENCODE_ROOT} failed"
elif ! curl -fsSL --max-time 60 "${OPENCODE_INSTALL_URL}" -o /tmp/opencode-install.sh; then
    mios_warn "Could not fetch opencode installer from ${OPENCODE_INSTALL_URL}"
else
    _oc_ver_env=""
    if [[ "${OPENCODE_VERSION}" != "latest" && -n "${OPENCODE_VERSION}" ]]; then
        _oc_ver_env="${OPENCODE_VERSION}"
    fi
    OPENCODE_INSTALL_DIR="${OPENCODE_BIN_DIR}" \
    OPENCODE_VERSION="${_oc_ver_env}" \
        bash /tmp/opencode-install.sh 2>&1 | tail -10 || \
        mios_warn "Opencode installer exited non-zero"
    rm -f /tmp/opencode-install.sh 2>/dev/null || true

    if [[ ! -x "${OPENCODE_BIN}" ]]; then
        for cand in "${OPENCODE_BIN_DIR}/opencode" "${OPENCODE_ROOT}/opencode" \
                    "${HOME:-/root}/.opencode/bin/opencode" /root/.opencode/bin/opencode \
                    /var/home/mios/.opencode/bin/opencode; do
            if [[ -x "$cand" ]]; then
                if [[ "$cand" != "${OPENCODE_BIN}" ]]; then
                    install -d -m 0755 "${OPENCODE_BIN_DIR}"
                    install -m 0755 "$cand" "${OPENCODE_BIN}" \
                        && mios_ok "Copied opencode ${cand} -> ${OPENCODE_BIN}"
                fi
                break
            fi
        done
    fi

    if [[ -x "${OPENCODE_BIN}" ]]; then
        ln -sf "${OPENCODE_BIN}" /usr/local/bin/opencode 2>/dev/null || true
        record_version "opencode" "${OPENCODE_VERSION}" "$("${OPENCODE_BIN}" --version 2>&1 | head -1 || echo unknown)" 2>/dev/null || true
        mios_ok "Installed opencode ${OPENCODE_BIN}"
    else
        mios_warn "Opencode binary not found at ${OPENCODE_BIN} or fallbacks"
    fi
fi

# The global agent CLI catalog ([agent_cli].tools) under [agent_cli].linux_prefix
# with its /usr/bin wrappers -- the payload `mios agents --install` installs. Every
# MiOS image carries it, so the devcontainer and the cloud sessions (which run this
# image) start with every catalogued CLI. A failed install fails the build.
_ac_src="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
_ac_enabled="$(MIOS_TOML_ROOT="$_ac_src" python3 "$_ac_src/usr/libexec/mios/mios-toml-get" --vendor agent_cli enabled)"
if [[ "$_ac_enabled" == true ]]; then
    mios_log "Install the [agent_cli].tools catalog"
    /usr/lib/mios/mcp/.venv/bin/python3 /usr/libexec/mios/mios-mcp-server --agent-cli --install \
        || { mios_err "Agent CLI catalog install failed"; exit 1; }
else
    mios_skip "[agent_cli].enabled is '${_ac_enabled}'; agent CLIs not installed"
fi

mios_ok "Done"
exit 0

entries.title: 73-model-prep.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=universal
# AI-hint: MiOS AI model-weight bake for BOTH local /v1 lanes -- llama.cpp GGUFs and the vLLM snapshot.
# AI-doc: usr/share/doc/mios/manual/automation.md

# AI-hint: Bakes GGUF weights into /usr/share/mios/llamacpp/models based on MIOS_LLAMACPP_BAKE_MODELS config to enable the offline mios-llm-light lane; agents use this to ens...
# AI-doc: usr/share/doc/mios/manual/automation.md
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=usr/lib/mios/log.sh
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done

source "$(dirname "$0")/lib/common.sh" 2>/dev/null || {
    mios_warn "Lib/common.sh unavailable"
    exit 0
}

SPEC="${MIOS_LLAMACPP_BAKE_MODELS:-}"
SEED_DIR="${MIOS_LLAMACPP_MODELS_DIR:?SSOT models directory unresolved}"
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname "$SEED_DIR")"

if [[ -z "$SPEC" ]]; then
    mios_log "MIOS_LLAMACPP_BAKE_MODELS empty"
    rm -rf "$SEED_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
    ln -sf /var/lib/mios/llamacpp/models "$SEED_DIR"
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -L "$SEED_DIR" ]]; then
    rm -f "$SEED_DIR"
fi
install -d -m 0755 "$SEED_DIR"
rm -f "${SEED_DIR}/.ready"

baked=0
requested=0
IFS=',' read -ra _entries <<< "$SPEC"
for entry in "${_entries[@]}"; do
    entry="$(printf '%s' "$entry" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
    [[ -z "$entry" ]] && continue
    requested=$((requested + 1))
    dest="${entry%%=*}"
    rest="${entry#*=}"
    repo="${rest%%:*}"
    file="${rest#*:}"
    if [[ -z "$dest" || -z "$repo" || -z "$file" || "$dest" == "$entry" || "$repo" == "$rest" ]]; then
        mios_warn "Malformed entry '${entry}'"
        continue
    fi
    if [[ -s "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}" ]]; then
        mios_skip "${dest} already present"
        baked=$((baked + 1))
        continue
    fi
    _url="https://huggingface.co/${repo}/resolve/main/${file}"
    if [ -f "/usr/share/mios/vendored/models/${dest}" ]; then
        mios_log "Found offline vendored model ${dest}, using it"
        cp "/usr/share/mios/vendored/models/${dest}" "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}"
        baked=$((baked + 1))
    elif curl -fL -C - --retry 3 --max-time 1800 \
            -o "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}.part" "$_url" \
       && [[ -s "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}.part" ]]; then
        mv -f "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}.part" "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}"
        baked=$((baked + 1))
        mios_ok "Baked ${repo}:${file} -> ${dest}"

        sbom_dir="/usr/share/mios/artifacts/sbom"
        mkdir -p "$sbom_dir"
        sha=""
        if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sha="$(sha256sum "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}" | awk '{print $1}')"
        fi
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$dest" "gguf" "$repo" "$file" "${sha:-unknown}" >> "${sbom_dir}/models.tsv"
    else
        rm -f "${SEED_DIR}/${dest}.part" 2>/dev/null || true
        mios_warn "Download failed for ${repo}:${file}"
    fi
done

if [[ "$requested" -gt 0 && "$baked" -eq "$requested" ]]; then
    : > "${SEED_DIR}/.ready"   # the quadlet's ConditionPathExists gate -> lane eligible
    seed_size="$(du -sh "$SEED_DIR" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
    mios_ok "Baked ${baked} GGUF -> ${SEED_DIR} (${seed_size:-?}); .ready set"
else
    mios_err "Incomplete GGUF bake: ${baked}/${requested}; required model files missing, .ready withheld"
    exit 1
fi

# AI-hint: Bakes vLLM model weights into the image at /usr/share/mios/vllm/model if MIOS_VLLM_BAKE_MODEL is set, enabling offline serving via the mios-llm-heavy Quadlet (vLLM or SGLang per [ai].heavy_engine) for air-gapped environments.
# AI-related: /usr/share/mios/vllm/model, mios-llm-heavy, mios-grounding, mios-llm-heavy.container

MODEL="${MIOS_VLLM_BAKE_MODEL:-}"
SEED_DIR="/usr/share/mios/vllm/model"
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname "$SEED_DIR")"

if [[ -z "$MODEL" ]]; then
    mios_log "MIOS_VLLM_BAKE_MODEL empty"
    rm -rf "$SEED_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
    ln -sf /var/lib/mios/vllm/model "$SEED_DIR"
else

if [[ -L "$SEED_DIR" ]]; then
    rm -f "$SEED_DIR"
fi
if [[ -d "$SEED_DIR" ]] && [[ -n "$(ls -A "$SEED_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
    mios_skip "seed already present at ${SEED_DIR}"
    exit 0
fi

install -d -m 0755 "$SEED_DIR"

if ! python3 - "$MODEL" "$SEED_DIR" <<'PY'
import sys, os
os.makedirs("/usr/local/lib", exist_ok=True)
try:
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
except Exception:
    import subprocess
    os.makedirs("/tmp/hf_hub", exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-q", "--target", "/tmp/hf_hub",
                    "huggingface_hub"], check=False)
    sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/hf_hub")
    import importlib
    importlib.invalidate_caches()
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
model, dest = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
snapshot_download(repo_id=model, local_dir=dest,
                  ignore_patterns=["*.pth", "original/*", "*.gguf"])
print(f"baked {model} -> {dest}")
PY
then
    mios_warn "Download failed"
    exit 1
fi

sbom_dir="/usr/share/mios/artifacts/sbom"
mkdir -p "$sbom_dir"
sbom_file="${sbom_dir}/models.tsv"
if [[ -d "$SEED_DIR" ]]; then
    find "$SEED_DIR" -type f | while read -r filepath; do
        relpath="${filepath#$SEED_DIR/}"
        sha=""
        if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sha="$(sha256sum "$filepath" | awk '{print $1}')"
        fi
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$relpath" "safetensors" "$MODEL" "$relpath" "${sha:-unknown}" >> "$sbom_file"
    done
fi

seed_size="$(du -sh "$SEED_DIR" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
mios_ok "Baked ${MODEL} -> ${SEED_DIR} (${seed_size:-?})"
fi
exit 0

entries.title: 75-kargs-render.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Projects kernel arguments from mios.toml [kargs] SSOT into /usr/lib/bootc/kargs.d via miosd, resolved by absolute path.
# AI-related: usr/share/mios/mios.toml, usr/lib/bootc/kargs.d, src/mios-rs/miosd/src/main.rs, usr/lib/mios/log.sh
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done

mios_log "Kargs.d render"

TOML_FILE="${MIOS_TOML:-/usr/share/mios/mios.toml}"
KARGS_DIR="${KARGS_DIR:-/usr/lib/bootc/kargs.d}"
_here="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

if [[ ! -f "$TOML_FILE" ]]; then
    mios_err "manifest file $TOML_FILE not found"
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -d "$KARGS_DIR" ]]; then
    mios_warn "$KARGS_DIR not found, skipping kargs render"
    exit 0
fi

# Absolute path, never `command -v`: miosd installs to /usr/libexec/mios, which
# is not on PATH at bake time, so the lookup this replaced could never succeed
# and the branch below it was dead on every build (task_962).
_miosd=""
for _c in "${MIOS_MIOSD_BIN:-}" \
          /usr/libexec/mios/miosd \
          "$_here/../src/mios-rs/target/release/miosd" \
          "$_here/../src/mios-rs/target/debug/miosd"; do
    if [ -n "$_c" ] && [ -x "$_c" ]; then _miosd="$_c"; break; fi
done

if [ -z "$_miosd" ]; then
    mios_err "miosd not found -- cannot render kargs. Build it: cd src/mios-rs && cargo build --release -p miosd"
    exit 2
fi

"$_miosd" render-kargs --toml "$TOML_FILE" --kargs-dir "$KARGS_DIR"
mios_ok "Kargs.d rendered via miosd"

entries.title: 76-uki-render.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Processes boot arguments from kargs.d/*.toml files into a single string at /usr/lib/kernel/cmdline to prepare the Unified Kernel Image (UKI) during the build or deployment phase.
set -euo pipefail

# shellcheck source=/dev/null
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done

mios_log "Render kernel cmdline from bootc kargs.d/*.toml for the UKI"

source "$(dirname "$0")/lib/packages.sh"
source "$(dirname "$0")/lib/common.sh"

if ! rpm -q systemd-ukify >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mios_log "Systemd-ukify not found; reinstalling via mios.toml [packages.uki]"
    install_packages_strict "uki"
fi

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
KERNEL_CMDLINE_DST="/usr/lib/kernel/cmdline"
install -d -m 0755 /usr/lib/kernel

# Folded from 02-uki-bootloader.sh (task_3454): ensure 02-security.conf cmdline drop-in exists
install -d -m 0755 "${ROOT}/etc/cmdline.d"
[[ -f "${ROOT}/etc/cmdline.d/02-security.conf" ]] || echo "module.sig_enforce=1 lockdown=confidentiality" > "${ROOT}/etc/cmdline.d/02-security.conf"

# Absolute path, never `command -v`: miosd installs to /usr/libexec/mios, which
# nothing puts on PATH at bake time, so the lookup this replaced could never
# succeed and the branch below it was dead on every build (task_962).
_miosd=""
for _c in "${MIOS_MIOSD_BIN:-}" \
          /usr/libexec/mios/miosd \
          "${ROOT}/src/mios-rs/target/release/miosd" \
          "${ROOT}/src/mios-rs/target/debug/miosd"; do
    if [[ -n "$_c" && -x "$_c" ]]; then _miosd="$_c"; break; fi
done

# The daemon and CLI call the same Rust projection library. Pass the root
# explicitly so the input directory and output file cannot follow the cwd.
if [[ -n "$_miosd" ]]; then
    mios_log "Render UKI cmdline via miosd"
    MIOS_ROOT="$ROOT" "$_miosd" render-uki-cmdline
else
    _unit_gen=""
    for _c in /usr/libexec/mios/mios-unit-gen \
              "${ROOT}/tools/native/target/release/mios-unit-gen" \
              "${ROOT}/tools/native/target/debug/mios-unit-gen"; do
        if [[ -n "$_c" && -x "$_c" ]]; then _unit_gen="$_c"; break; fi
    done
    if [[ -z "$_unit_gen" ]] || ! "$_unit_gen" --list-projections | grep -Fxq uki-cmdline; then
        mios_err "mios-unit-gen with uki-cmdline support is required; rebuild it in MiOS-DEV"
        exit 1
    fi
    mios_log "Render UKI cmdline via mios-unit-gen"
    "$_unit_gen" uki-cmdline --root "$ROOT"
fi

if [[ "${ROOT}/usr/lib/kernel/cmdline" != "${KERNEL_CMDLINE_DST}" ]]; then
    install -D -m 0644 "${ROOT}/usr/lib/kernel/cmdline" "${KERNEL_CMDLINE_DST}"
fi

CMDLINE=$(cat "${KERNEL_CMDLINE_DST}" | xargs)
if [ -z "$CMDLINE" ]; then
    mios_warn "/usr/lib/kernel/cmdline empty"
fi

mios_ok "Rendered UKI cmdline: $CMDLINE"
mios_ok "UKI cmdline rendered"

entries.title: 77-composefs-verity.sh
entries.full_content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MIOS_APPLY_CLASS=bake-only
# AI-hint: Configures the `prepare-root.conf` file by reading the `[security].composefs_mode` setting from `mios.toml` to ...
# AI-doc: usr/share/doc/mios/manual/automation.md
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=/dev/null  # Resolve the repository or installed FHS logging library.
for _mlog in "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../usr/lib/mios/log.sh" /usr/lib/mios/log.sh; do [ -r "$_mlog" ] && . "$_mlog" && break; done
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/common.sh"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/packages.sh"

_read_mios_scalar() {
    local table="$1" key="$2" toml_path
    toml_path="$(_resolve_mios_toml 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [[ -n "$toml_path" && -f "$toml_path" ]] || return 0
    awk -v table="$table" -v key="$key" '
        /^\[/ {
            in_section = 0
            line = $0
            sub(/^\[/, "", line); sub(/\][[:space:]]*$/, "", line)
            gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", line)
            if (line == table) in_section = 1
            next
        }
        in_section {
            if (match($0, "^[[:space:]]*" key "[[:space:]]*=")) {
                value = $0
                sub(/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*/, "", value)
                sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*$/, "", value)
                gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", value)
                gsub(/^"|"$/, "", value)
                print value
                exit 0
            }
        }
    ' "$toml_path"
}

MODE="$(_read_mios_scalar security composefs_mode)"
MODE="${MODE:-verity}"
MASK_REMOUNT="$(_read_mios_scalar security mask_systemd_remount_fs)"
MASK_REMOUNT="${MASK_REMOUNT:-true}"

case "$MODE" in
    verity|yes|off) ;;
    *)
        mios_warn "Unknown composefs_mode='${MODE}', falling back to 'verity'"
        MODE="verity"
        ;;
esac

if [[ "$MODE" == "off" ]]; then
    mios_skip "composefs_mode=off -- honoring base image's prepare-root.conf"
    exit 0
fi

conf="${COMPOSEFS_CONF:-/usr/lib/ostree/prepare-root.conf}"
if [[ -f "$conf" ]]; then
    if [[ ! -f "${conf}.orig" ]]; then
        mios_log "Backing up existing $conf -> ${conf}.orig"
        cp -a "$conf" "${conf}.orig"
    fi
fi

mios_log "Writing $conf with composefs mode=${MODE}"
# The hint is part of the projection: the tracked copy is gated byte-for-byte
# against this output (check_composefs_projection) and must carry a header.
cat > "$conf" <<EOF
# AI-hint: ostree prepare-root (composefs mode, root/etc mount policy); generated from mios.toml [security].composefs_mode by automation/77-composefs-verity.sh.
[composefs]
enabled = ${MODE}

[root]
transient = false

[etc]
transient = false
EOF

if [[ "$MODE" == "verity" && "$MASK_REMOUNT" =~ ^(true|TRUE|1|yes|YES)$ ]]; then
    mios_log "Masking systemd-remount-fs.service"
    install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system
    ln -sf /dev/null /etc/systemd/system/systemd-remount-fs.service
fi

mios_ok "Composefs mode=${MODE} configured"
